headline: Approved prior meeting minutes; discussed last-minute details for the Veterans Day service.
summary: Discussion covered last-minute details for the Veterans Day service. Afterward, the group went to Council Chambers to place flags. A moment of silence was held for departed members.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the previous meeting as submitted.

decision_evidence.quote: Minutes for previous meeting approved as submitted.

plain_text:
VETERAN’S MEMORIAL COMMITTEE 
 
Meeting of the Veterans Memorial Committee was held on November 9, 2026 at Wallingford Town Hall 
Room 220. Chairman Ruth Palmer called the meeting to order at 1900. There were 9 members present.  
 
Minutes for previous meeting approved as submitted. 
 
This meeting is to wrap Veterans Day service. 
 
Miscellaneous discussion held regarding last minute details; went into Council Chambers for placement of 
flags, etc. 
 
Next meeting is November 16, 2026 at 1900 at Wallingford Town Hall Room 220.  
 
Meeting adjourned at 1914 after a moment of silence for departed members. 
 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
 
 
Elise M. Gallup 
Secretary
